sources.story_title: CLAIM (Gov. Mike Dunleavy): five to seven cent kWh gas for 20 or 30 years for data farms and crypto
CLAIM repeated (Dunleavy at Data Center World): ~5 cents/kWh for industrial users; 'By 2031, you've got the gas line'
COUNTER (primary): Chugach 'We currently do not have gas to serve a large data center'; Pickett 'world of hurt'; Golden Valley gas 30% to <1%
COUNTER: large commercial users pay 14-17 cents/kWh vs VA 8.99, TX 6.12, WA 6.61; 'the answer is no'
COUNTER: three 3-GW data centers would burn 585 BCF/yr, 8x the 75 BCF the entire Railbelt uses
